description: Bootstrap approximation of the family-wise minimum-p null distribution for the 648-row all_available coverage grid, using each trial's own stored N_null=100 matched-null draws (leave-one-out p-values), resampled assuming trial independence.
caveat: Resamples each of the 648 trials independently; does not reproduce the real positive correlation between trials sharing a background cell/beam/geometry. Lightweight approximation, not an exact joint permutation test.
